name: Harumi Sou Monogatari
source:
Main character takes a part-time job to get residents out of their homes prior to building demolishing. He pretends to be apartment keeper and uses any means possible to expel residents who are all pretty girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
为了在拆除公寓楼前让住户搬走，主人公接下了一份兼职。他假扮成公寓管理员，不择手段地驱逐住在这里的居民——而她们全都是漂亮女孩。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
